Assumptions

Speed = unit speed × terrain (plains, hills, mountains, forest, urban) × 0.5 on enemy ground (a province becomes yours once the stack reaches its centre: from there to the border the ×0.5 no longer applies, the terrain still does). A stack moves as fast as its slowest unit. At sea your units sail as a convoy (Transport Ship, speed by convoy level). Planes fly in a straight line; moving to another airfield adds 30 min (not for Flying Bomb and Rocket: they do not land; not for a patrol that starts from the airfield). Tested: Allies Interceptor L1 Hamilton → Toronto = 34m 52s. Embarking and landing take 3 hours each in your own province and 4.5 hours in someone else's. The stack first walks to the coast and after landing from the coast to the centre. The convoy sails at the game value × 20 km/h (the game shows × 30). Tested: Casablanca → Cadiz = 13h 00m 48s and Casablanca → Havana = 1d 9h 38m 33s (Infantry, convoy L1). Routes follow the connection lines from the game's own map (via border points, also at sea); each part counts with the terrain of that area. AI movements come later.

Tested against the game: Bathurst → Moncton (Infantry), Toronto → Orillia (Militia) and Ottawa → Kingston (SP Artillery) match to the second. Travel time = distance ÷ (unit speed × 60) hours.
